notes: Content amount (Dense / Relaxed / Minimal) now works on the OG Widget, and is remembered per panel instead of being one shared setting. Choosing it reopens the panel you are actually looking at.

Why it had never worked there: OG is its own panel with its own window, but the setting was stored as a single app-wide value that only the Hardware Panel's reopen path ever read — so the choice was saved, a different window was reopened…

Removed a retired panel's leftover window handle from the main process. It had been declared but never filled in since the old Classic panel was withdrawn, and around forty places still read it — each one quietly doing nothing. That is the…

Two of those places were reconnected to the real panel window rather than deleted: which monitor the panel occupies now informs layout selection, and the primary panel refreshes its generated content again.

The Panel Settings capability check was counting channels that do not exist. It resolved shorthand variable names across a whole file at once, so two different groups of settings borrowed each other's methods and it reported thirty-five…
